boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
entries.target: 这只绿皮丑陋的庞大人形生物正盯着你，同时它握紧了满是疣的绿色拳头。

entries.source: Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
entries.target: 这只绿皮丑陋的庞大人形生物正盯着你，同时它握紧了满是疣的绿色拳头。

entries.source: WAIT HERE. THERE'S A GOOD CHANCE YOU'LL GET BLOWN INTO ADVENTURER KIBBLE IF YOU STEP INSIDE THIS BUILDING. MY ROBE OF MAD ALCHEMIST PROTECTION IS THE ONLY REASON I'M NOT VAPOUR.
entries.target: 在这儿等着就好，如果你进入这栋建筑，你会有幸成为冒险家牌肉松。全靠我这件疯炼金术士防护袍的保护，我才没变成粉蒸肉。

entries.source: Alchemists can bind gems to armour to grant them magical effects, to protect the wearer or improve their powers. Some commercial alchemists can imbue gems into jewellery.
entries.target: 炼金术士可以把宝石镶嵌到盔甲上，赋予其魔法效果，以保护穿戴者或增强其能力。一些提供商业服务的炼金术士还能把宝石镶嵌到首饰中。

entries.source: replaced by a time clone (and no one ever knew the difference)
entries.target: 被一个时间克隆体取代（其他人均不会感到任何差别）

entries.source:
Deploy a noisy lure that attracts all creatures within radius %d to it for %d turns.
		It has %d life (based on your Cunning) and is very durable, with %d armor and %d%% resistance to non-physical damage.
		At level 5, when the lure is destroyed, it will trigger some traps in a radius of 2 around it (check individual trap descriptions to see if they are triggered).
		Use of this talent will not break stealth.
entries.target:
抛出一个诱饵来吸引 %d 码半径内的所有生物，持续 %d 回合。
		诱饵有 %d 生命（基于灵巧），且非常坚韧，拥有 %d 护甲和 %d%% 非物理伤害抗性。
		在等级 5 时，当诱饵被摧毁时，它会触发其周围 2 码范围内的部分陷阱（请查看各陷阱自身的说明，以确认其是否会被触发）。
		此技能不会打断潜行状态。

entries.source: A complementing item would be your crowning glory.
entries.target: 再补齐一件配套的套装部件，将成为你至高无上的荣耀。

entries.source: We preserve the past to protect the future. The hands of time are guarded by the arms of war.
entries.target: 我们守护过去，以护佑未来。时间之手由战争之臂守卫。

entries.source:
#{bold}#Relle, Cornac Fighter and Expedition Leader#{normal}#
It knows we're here.  Xann's gone, and I have to assume the worst.  Too late to run.  One option left, a contraption Sodelost ensured us he'd be able to use to get the kill...  shame he didn't leave instructions behind with it, it's unclear how to arm it, and I don't want to add "being frozen solid" to my list of troubles today.
I might not know a great deal about artifice, but I know how wild animals work, and for all the praise they get, dragons are no better.  I don't need to know how to rig this device so it goes off when the beast steps on it - I just need to put it inside something it'll eat whole...
#{italic}#Judging from this note's intact state and delicate placement next to a sack covered in assorted animal viscera, the dragon not only avoided setting off the trap, but has kept it as a trophy.  Inside the sack is a disarmed trap featuring a few recognizable alchemical flasks, and a means of mixing them in the right proportion when a pressure plate is triggered to produce a blast of ice. Figuring out how to arm it is almost as easy as figuring out how to make more traps like it.#{normal}#
entries.target:
#{bold}#探险队队长，科纳克人战士瑞丽#{normal}#
那条龙知道我们在这里。希安失踪了，我只能作最坏的打算。逃跑已经太迟。只剩一个选择：苏达罗斯特向我们保证，他能用这套装置杀死那条龙……可惜他没把说明留在装置旁边，没人知道该如何启动它，而我可不想让今天的麻烦清单再多出“被彻底冻住”这一项。
我或许不太懂机关术，却知道野兽会怎么做。龙尽管备受赞颂，在这一点上也不比其他野兽高明。我无需知道怎样把装置设成野兽踩中时触发——只须将它放进某种会被一口吞下的东西里……
#{italic}#从纸条完好无损的状态，以及它被小心摆放在一个沾满各种动物内脏的袋子旁边来看，那条龙不仅没有触发陷阱，还把它当作战利品收藏了起来。袋中有一个已解除的陷阱，装有几只尚能辨认的炼金药瓶；压力板触发时，机关会按正确比例混合其中的药剂，爆发出寒冰。弄清如何启动它，几乎与弄清如何制作更多同类陷阱一样简单。#{normal}#

entries.source: An orc dressed in putrid robes. He mumbles in a harsh tongue.
entries.target: 一个穿着腐烂长袍的兽人。他用刺耳的语言喃喃自语。

entries.source:
You pause time around you long enough to fire a single shot, doing %d%% damage.
		The damage will scale with your Paradox and the cooldown will go down with more talent points invested.
entries.target:
你暂停时间给你足够的空闲射出一支箭，造成 %d%% 伤害。
		伤害受紊乱值影响，按比例加成，另外技能等级提高可以降低冷却时间。
一双被火焰覆盖的草鞋

entries.source: I don't trust you. Please go away.

Numbing Poison - Reduces global speed by %d%% for 5 turns.
		Insidious Poison - Applies a standard poison that deals %0.2f nature damage over 5 turns.
		Crippling Poison - Places %d talents on cooldown for %d turns.
		Leeching Poison - Heals you for %d.
		Volatile Poison - Deals a further %0.2f nature damage to foes in a radius %d ball.
entries.target:
麻痹毒素——全局速度降低 %d%%，持续 5 回合。
		阴险毒素——使目标中毒，在 5 回合内受到 %0.2f 点自然伤害。
		致残毒素——令 %d 个技能进入 %d 回合冷却。
		吸血毒素——为你恢复 %d 点生命。
		易爆毒素——额外造成 %0.2f 点自然伤害，波及半径 %d 内的敌人。

entries.source: Humans are split into two categories: the Highers, and the rest. Highers have latent magic in their blood which gives them higher attributes and senses along with a longer life.
entries.target: 人类被分为两个亚种：高等人类和普通人类。高等人类体内流淌着魔法的血液，他们拥有额外的属性和感知能力并更长寿。

entries.source: #F53CBE#Your rampage is invigorated by the collosal slam! (+1 duration)
entries.target: #F53CBE#巨力猛击激发了你的暴走！（+1 持续时间）

entries.source: 20% chance to make the target bleed shadows. You heal for 15 whenever you hit an enemy bleeding shadows.
entries.target: 有20%的几率让目标流出阴影。每当你击中流出阴影的敌人，恢复15点生命值。

entries.source: #YELLOW#The air comes alive with terrible magics!
entries.target: #YELLOW#在可怕的魔法中空气似乎获得了生命！

entries.source: which you do not understand: #{italic}#'Fa AMAKTHEL tabak, ik koru bazan tro yu, ik ranaheli tobol don schek ruun. Ik blana dem Soli as banafel ik goriz uf Eyal ik blod, "Tro fasa goru domus asam, ik goru domit tro Eyal."'#{normal}#
entries.target: 不明意义的文字：#{italic}#'Fa AMAKTHEL tabak, ik koru bazan tro yu, ik ranaheli tobol don schek ruun. Ik blana dem Soli as banafel ik goriz uf Eyal ik blod, "Tro fasa goru domus asam, ik goru domit tro Eyal."'#{normal}#

entries.source: Claws and teeth. Ice and death. Dragons are not all extinct it seems...  and this one seems to have been corrupted by the time rift.
entries.target: 尖牙利齿，冰冷致命。似乎龙族并没有完全灭绝……并且这只似乎被时空能量所扭曲。

entries.source: Sleek, majestic, powerful... In the path of dragons we walk, and their breath is our breath. See their beating hearts with your eyes and taste their majesty between your teeth.
entries.target: 矫健、雄壮、强大……我们行走在巨龙之道上，它们的吐息便是我们的吐息。用你的双眼凝视它们跳动的心脏，在你的齿间品味它们的威严。

entries.source: A stream of acid gushes onto @target@!
The target is partially removed from the timeline, reducing all damage dealt by %d%%, all damage received by %d%%, and the duration of all detrimental effects by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标暂时被从时间线中移除，造成的伤害减少 %d%%，减少受到伤害 %d%%，并减少 %d%% 回合所有不良效果持续时间。

entries.source: What would happen if more of Ureslak's remains were reunited?
entries.target: 当乌尔斯拉克更多遗物聚集在一起时，会发生什么呢？

entries.source: Zemekkys points to the location of Briagh's lair on your map.
entries.target: 泽梅基斯在你的地图上指出了布莱亚的巢穴的位置。
通用 增加物理抗性穿透

entries.source: That could be quite useful. Yes, please do it.
Time and space collapse in upon this erratically-moving time elemental.
entries.target: 时空在这只漂泊的时间元素周围不断塌陷。

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#%s is infused with all the energies of the fragments. The real Harkor'Zun is reconstituted!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#%s吸收了所有碎片的能量，真正的哈卡祖重生了！

entries.source: The target has assumed the form of a corrupted losgoroth, gaining immunity to poison, disease, bleeding, and confusion.  It does not need to breathe, and converts half of all damage to life draining blight.
entries.target: 目标呈现出堕落的罗斯戈洛斯形态。获得毒素、疾病、流血和混乱免疫。不需要呼吸，将所造成的一半伤害转化为枯萎吸血伤害。

entries.source: Hurry down south while the sun-paladins are holding off the orcs. Make their sacrifice worth it!
entries.target: 太阳骑士在这里挡住了兽人，请快向南方过去，不要让他们的牺牲白费！

entries.source: You are transformed by the corrupted heart of the Queen!
entries.target: 你被腐化的沙虫女皇之心所转化！

entries.source: You cannot use Shield Wall without a shield!
entries.target: 必须装备一面盾牌施展该技能！

entries.source: Most skeletons announce their presence with a chorus of rattling bones; this one's been charred black and has enough cartilage between its joints to muffle its approach.  The first you'll see of it will be the flash of its blade.
entries.target: 普通骷髅骨节之间的吱嘎猛响会早早暴露他们的行踪，但这只骷髅的身躯被烧焦成暗夜的黑色，关节间的软骨缓冲着骨节的转动。当你看到它时，它银光闪耀的刀刃已经出现在你的眼前。

entries.source: Garkul's spirit is with you. You now deal 1000%% more damage to constructs and 20%% more damage to humanoids and giants.
entries.target: 加库尔之魂与你同在，你现在能对构装生物造成 1000%% 额外伤害，对人形生物和巨人造成 20%% 额外伤害。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed two invocation portals.
entries.target: 在关闭2扇传送门的情况下，杀死2名巫师。

entries.source:
Briefly extend your telekinetic reach to grab an enemy, haul them towards you and daze them for 1 turn.
		Works on enemies up to %d squares away.
		The cooldown decreases, and the range increases, with additional talent points spent.
entries.target:
用灵能将远处的敌人抓过来，并使其眩晕1回合。
		至多对半径 %d 的敌人有效。
		范围和冷却时间受技能等级影响。
